verdict.rationale: The pack shows only that Square has an Invoices API (a bare title) and that 'invoices' is one of the services the MCP server can reach. Separately, it documents general online payment acceptance (card, ACH, Cash App). Nothing describes what invoices actually do, so delivery of the story is only glancingly evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of hosted/shareable invoice pages, invoice-specific online payment, automatic payment reminders, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
